breakdown.description: The prompt states significant losses but then assumes an ideal lossless Venturi (Cd=1).
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the core contradiction. The incomplete prompt mentioned 'significant irreversible losses' but then incorrectly asked to use an ideal model (Cd=1). The agent repeated this error by specifying 'Calculation shall use ideal Bernoulli equation with discharge coefficient (Cd) = 1'. The ground truth correctly resolves this by stating that a model with losses should use a discharge coefficient less than 1 (Cd<1).
